pages.title: Comparing Values
pages.content: Comparison operators compare two values and return a Boolean. Python uses `==` (equal), `!=` (not equal), `>` (greater), `<` (less), `>=` (greater or equal), `<=` (less or equal).

pages.title: Examples
pages.code:
print(5 == 5)   # True
print(5 != 3)   # True
print(5 > 10)   # False
print(3 <= 3)   # True
print(7 >= 8)   # False

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: Which operator checks if two values are NOT equal?
pages.explanation: In Python, != is the not-equal operator.
